summary: Chapter 3 closes both cases in concrete, procedural beats (the report, Berta's flat confirmation, Rutz's wordless nod, the two files side by side) but is undercut by an invented named clerk, a paragraph that abstracts its own scene instead of showing it, and a paragraph whose two sentences flatly contradict each other.

issues.unit: P5: "Gemeindeschreiber Anton Hürlimann, der am Fenster saß, trug die Unterschrift"
issues.fix_hint: Cut the name; refer to him unnamed, e.g. "der Schreiber am Fenster trug die Unterschrift ins Register ein" — canon has no such person and the scene's present-list does not include him.

issues.unit: P11: "über alles, was zwischen ihnen stand. Die Spannung im Raum wuchs."
issues.fix_hint: Replace with what was actually said and the concrete signs of tension (a gesture, a pause, a specific line); as written the sentence names a feeling instead of showing the scene that would produce it.

issues.unit: P15: "Gleich nach Mittag hatte er das Amtszimmer verlassen und war nicht zurückgekehrt."
issues.fix_hint: Cut this sentence — it directly contradicts the paragraph's own first sentence, "Er blieb bis zum Abend im Amtszimmer."

issues.unit: P8: "Vom Flur aus reichte Feuz ihm die Mappe noch einmal über den"
issues.fix_hint: Clarify Feuz's position — he was just said to have put on his coat and left; state whether he is back at the desk or still framed in the doorway so the handoff over the desk is physically legible.

issues.unit: P22: "Zwei Finger breit lag zwischen ihnen."
issues.fix_hint: Match this gap to P21's "wenige Fächer neben einem anderen" — either make the slots plainly adjacent in P21 or widen the gap described here, so the two distances describe the same shelf.

issues.unit: P25: "Der Fall Aebischer war abgeschlossen, wie der Fall Vogel abgeschlossen war"
issues.fix_hint: Cut this closing sentence — the closed, filed, locked state was already shown concretely in P20–P24; this only restates it in the abstract.
